description: This file contains an implementation of an immutable, thread-safe logger wrapping SLF4J Logger with MDC support, called ImmutableDittoLogger.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLogger
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe logger implementation that wraps an SLF4J Logger, supporting MDC entries and correlation IDs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableDittoLogger from an SLF4J Logger.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the underlying logger.

methods.name: isTraceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TRACE level logging is enabled.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a TRACE level message with various overloads.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if DEBUG level logging is enabled.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a DEBUG level message with various overloads.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if INFO level logging is enabled.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an INFO level message with various overloads.

methods.name: isWarnEnabled
methods.description: Checks if WARN level logging is enabled.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a WARN level message with various overloads.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if ERROR level logging is enabled.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an ERROR level message with various overloads.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns a new logger instance with the specified correlation ID added to the MDC.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Returns a new logger instance with a specific MDC key-value pair added.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns a new logger instance with the correlation ID removed from MDC.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries to a new logger instance.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC key from the logger, returning a new instance.
